title: PLAYER 2 HEARS HOW THE BOUNTY ENDS
why: When a bounty pillager ended, only the host window said it. v27.27 made player 2's kill of the bounty pillager claim the bounty, yet when player 2 made that kill the host heard BOUNTY CLAIMED and player 2 heard nothing; BOUNTY GONE (NOT YOUR KILL, HE GOT AWAY), BOUNTY SLIPPED AWAY and BOUNTY OVER (HE STAYS) were host only too. Proven in a staged pair in one window: in each of the five endings the host said its line and player 2 window said nothing. The host now notes which end line it said, the world word carries that code, and player 2 window says exactly that line when the bounty ends. Because it is the line the host said, not a guess from the pillager at the time of the word, it stays right when the pillager dies or leaves after the host spoke. It only says the line: the host still pays the chip, player 2 window pays nothing.
now: In co-op, both players now hear how the bounty ends, whoever made the kill.
